question: What is the average order value?
Revenue by region
oracle_sql: SELECT regions.region_name, SUM(revenue) FROM orders JOIN regions USING(region_id) GROUP BY regions.region_name ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: Revenue by category
oracle_sql: SELECT products.category, SUM(revenue) FROM orders JOIN products USING(product_id) GROUP BY products.category ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: Revenue and profit by category
oracle_sql: SELECT products.category, SUM(revenue), SUM(revenue-cost) FROM orders JOIN products USING(product_id) GROUP BY products.category ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: What was revenue in July 2026?
oracle_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-07-01' AND order_date < '2026-08-01'

question: Show monthly revenue from January through September 2026.
oracle_sql: SELECT substr(order_date,1,7), SUM(revenue) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: What was revenue last month?
oracle_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND order_date < '2026-10-01'

question: Revenue in the last 30 days
oracle_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-09-22' AND order_date < '2026-10-22'

question: Top 5 products by revenue
oracle_sql: SELECT products.product_name, SUM(revenue) FROM orders JOIN products USING(product_id) GROUP BY products.product_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

question: Top 2 products per category by revenue
oracle_sql: WITH g AS (SELECT products.category c, products.product_name p, SUM(revenue) v FROM orders JOIN products USING(product_id) GROUP BY c, p), r AS (SELECT c, p, v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY v DESC) rk FROM g) SELECT c, p, v FROM r WHERE rk <= 2 ORDER BY c, rk

question: In which months did revenue exceed 400000?
oracle_sql: SELECT substr(order_date,1,7), SUM(revenue) FROM orders GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(revenue) > 400000 ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: Why did revenue drop in July compared to June?
oracle_sql: WITH b AS (SELECT products.category c, SUM(revenue) v FROM orders JOIN products USING(product_id) WHERE order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY c), t AS (SELECT products.category c, SUM(revenue) v FROM orders JOIN products USING(product_id) WHERE order_date >= '2026-07-01' AND order_date < '2026-08-01' GROUP BY c) SELECT b.c, b.v, t.v, (t.v-b.v) FROM b LEFT JOIN t USING(c)
